rationale.ai-review: LLM judges assess bot comments; study exposes their reliability limits.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Developers must disposition every bot comment before PR merge.
rationale.routing-signal: Usefulness scores are framed to prioritize cases for manual inspection.
rationale.general-code: Bots review ordinary PR code, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.method-self-report: Semi-structured director interview contextualizes labels and workflow constraints.
rationale.method-mining: Analyzes production PR comments and developer disposition records.
rationale.method-experiment: Compares third-party LLM judges under controlled rubric and model variants.
